Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Generic Bidders shall quote only those products (Part of Service delivery) in the bid which are not obsolete in the market and has at least 3 years residual market life i.e. the offered product shall not be declared end-of- life by the OEM before this period. 4. 7. OEM IMPORTED PRODUCTS: In case of imported products, OEM or Authorized Seller of OEM should have a registered office in India to provide after sales service support in India. The certificate to this effect should be submitted. 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Condition of Items: All items supplied must be in new, unused, and undamaged co ndition. No item showing any physical damage shall be accepted. 2. Genuine OEM Products: All items supplied must be original and genuine products manufactured by the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM). Counterfeit, refurbishe d, or unauthorized products shall not be accepted. 3. OEM Undertaking for Genuine Supply: The bidder shall submit an undertaking fro m the OEM confirming the genuine supply of the quoted products along with the bid. 4. Physical Submission of EMD and MAF: The Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) and Ma nufacturer’s Authorization Form (MAF) shall be submitted physically at the Office of th e Police Commissioner before the bid opening date. Failure to submit the required doc uments within the stipulated time shall render the bid liable for rejection. 5. No Exemption from EMD: Exemption from submission of EMD shall not be permitte d. All bidders must submit the prescribed EMD in accordance with the tender conditio ns. 6. OEM Authorization for Quoted Products: The bidder shall submit an OEM Authori zation Letter, issued on the OEM’s official letterhead, specifically mentioning the rele vant bid number and the make and model of the quoted products. The authorization must also include the reference email address and contact number of the authorized OEM representative for verification purposes. 7. Compliance with GeM GTC Clause 26 — Restrictions on Procurement from Bi dders of Countries Sharing a Land Border with India: In accordance with Clause 26 of the GeM General Terms and Conditions (GTC), the bidder shall submit a Complia nce Letter/Declaration on the OEM’s official letterhead, in the prescribed format, clear ly specifying the make and model of the quoted products and confirming compliance with the applicable provisions concerning restrictions on procurement from bidders of countries sharing a land border with India. Non-submission of the required declaration , submission of any false declaration, or failure to comply with the applicable provisio ns shall constitute grounds for disqualification, termination of the contract, as applica ble, and initiation of further legal action in accordance with the applicable laws and ru les. .
